jit: And rabbits; red-eyed ones, white and shy, Ella'd set in the thick sparrow grass, guarded over by Jit, the dog, to play and frolic.
jit's: Vicious, stiff-haired boars who ate up the sow's young, frothed at the mouth at Jit's approach, tried to stick their snouts between Ella's legs whenever she ventured in the pen.
